Gives how far the two overlap, 0 if they only touch, for one of the contacts of the last `PhysicsUpdate` (see `GetPhysicsContactCount`). Points and directions are in the world.
@param index The contact, from 0 to the count minus 1.
@param world The physics world, 0 (default) for the default world.
@returns The value.
@gap The original has no such command. This is an extension; programs that use it do not compile with the original Blitz3D.
